item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Window counting followed by DISTINCT preserves one row per hour, including the NULL group, with BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Aggregate by pickup timestamp first, then combine counts by the original hour expression. Casting the sum to BIGINT preserves the original COUNT type.","sql":"SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, CAST(SUM(timestamp_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS timestamp_trips FROM trips GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime) AS timestamp_counts GROUP BY 1"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Filter before window counting, then collapse repeated route rows with DISTINCT. NULL route keys remain grouped together and duplicate trips remain counted.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Filtered aggregation counts qualifying trips within each route; HAVING removes routes with no qualifying trips while retaining BIGINT counts and the original date predicate.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"}]}
